entries.title: Green Thumb
entries.author: Matthew P
entries.body:
It's been a whirlwind of 24 hours. After play testing, I decided to shorten the game from 4 deck runs to 2 (the couple plays I was able to basically meet the goal within two runs and then it was just swapping cards back and forth, not so much fun, so now it is more cutthroat and quick and challenging) so had to pivot and make some big changes in rules and cards but I think it is all set! This was a blast and hope to join more in the future!

Green Thumb is Contest Ready!!

Link to Files

I was not able to try all the different plant cards to see if the values made sense. With more play testing, I would work on that to make sure the game is both challenging and enjoyable. I had fun playing my few rounds!

Happy Planting!!
